features.name: Expertise
features.summary: Pick two skill proficiencies (or one skill plus thieves' tools); your proficiency bonus is doubled for checks using them. Pick two more at 6th level.

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.summary: Once per turn, add the Sneak Attack dice to one finesse or ranged weapon hit if you have advantage, or if an active ally is within 5 ft. of the target and you lack disadvantage.

features.name: Thieves' Cant
features.summary: You know the secret rogue jargon for hiding messages in ordinary talk (takes four times as long) plus a set of signs and symbols for short coded messages.

features.name: Cunning Action
features.summary: Each turn in combat you may take a bonus action to Dash, Disengage, or Hide.

features.name: Roguish Archetype
features.summary: Choose Thief, Assassin, or Arcane Trickster; it grants features at 3rd, 9th, 13th, and 17th level.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.summary: At 4th, 8th, 10th, 12th, 16th, and 19th level, raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (maximum 20).

features.name: Uncanny Dodge
features.summary: Reaction: when an attacker you can see hits you, halve that attack's damage.

features.name: Evasion
features.summary: On a Dexterity save against an effect that deals half damage on success, you take none on a success and half on a failure.

features.name: Reliable Talent
features.summary: On any ability check that adds your proficiency bonus, a d20 roll of 9 or lower counts as 10.

features.name: Blindsense
features.summary: While you can hear, you know where any hidden or invisible creature within 10 ft. of you is.

features.name: Slippery Mind
features.summary: You become proficient in Wisdom saving throws.

features.name: Elusive
features.summary: Unless you are incapacitated, attack rolls against you can never have advantage.

features.name: Stroke of Luck
features.summary: Turn a missed attack against a target in range into a hit, or treat a failed ability check's d20 as a 20. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Fast Hands
features.summary: Cunning Action's bonus action can also be a Sleight of Hand check, using thieves' tools on a trap or lock, or the Use an Object action.

features.name: Second-Story Work
features.summary: Climbing costs no extra movement, and running jumps go farther by a number of feet equal to your Dexterity modifier.

features.name: Supreme Sneak
features.summary: Advantage on Stealth checks on a turn in which you move no more than half your speed.

features.name: Use Magic Device
features.summary: You disregard class, race, and level requirements when using magic items.

features.name: Thief's Reflexes
features.summary: In the first round of combat you take two turns: one at your initiative and a second at initiative minus 10. Not usable when surprised.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.summary: Gain proficiency with the disguise kit and the poisoner's kit.

features.name: Assassinate
features.summary: Advantage on attacks against creatures that have not yet acted in the combat; any hit against a surprised creature is a critical hit.

features.name: Infiltration Expertise
features.summary: Spend 7 days and 25 gp to build a reliable false identity (not someone else's); while you use it, others accept it unless given clear reason to doubt.

features.name: Impostor
features.summary: After 3 hours studying a person's speech, writing, and behaviour you can mimic them; casual observers are fooled and you get advantage on Deception checks to avoid detection.

features.name: Death Strike
features.summary: When you hit a surprised creature, it makes a Con save (DC 8 + Dex mod + prof); on a failure the attack's damage is doubled.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.summary: Int-based wizard spellcasting per the Arcane Trickster table: mage hand plus two other cantrips; leveled spells mostly enchantment or illusion, except those learned at 3rd, 8th, 14th, and 20th level, which may be any school.

features.name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
features.summary: Your mage hand can be invisible and can stow or retrieve items in containers others wear and use thieves' tools at range (Sleight of Hand vs. Perception to go unnoticed); control it with Cunning Action.

features.name: Magical Ambush
features.summary: If you are hidden when you cast a spell on a creature, it has disadvantage on saves against that spell this turn.

features.name: Versatile Trickster
features.summary: Bonus action: target a creature within 5 ft. of your mage hand to gain advantage on attacks against it until the end of the turn.

features.name: Spell Thief
features.summary: Reaction when a spell targets or includes you: caster saves with its spellcasting modifier vs. your DC; on a failure you negate it for you and, if it is 1st level or higher and castable by you, you know it for 8 hours while the caster cannot cast it.

discrepancies: Assassin subclass exists in the app (id 'assassin', srd false) but has an empty features list; PHB gives Bonus Proficiencies (3), Assassinate (3), Infiltration Expertise (9), Impostor (13), Death Strike (17).

Arcane Trickster subclass exists in the app (id 'arcane-trickster', srd false) but has an empty features list; PHB gives Spellcasting (3), Mage Hand Legerdemain (3), Magical Ambush (9), Versatile Trickster (13), Spell Thief (17).

Arcane Trickster spellcasting is not modelled at all: class spellAbility is null, every progression row has cantrips 0 / known 0 / all-zero slots, and the subclass has no override. PHB: Int caster on the wizard list, 3 cantrips at 3rd (4 at 10th), 3-13 spells known, slots up to 4th level (e.g. 4/3/3/1 at 20th).
No limited-use resources are tracked: Stroke of Luck (1 per short or long rest) and Arcane Trickster Spell Thief (1 per long rest) have no uses data in the app.
App features list contains generic 'Roguish Archetype feature' entries at 9, 13, 17 whose desc is a copy of the Roguish Archetype text; they are table placeholders rather than real features.

Proficiencies are a single merged list (armor, weapons, tools mixed). Content matches the book (light armor; simple weapons, hand crossbows, longswords, rapiers, shortswords; thieves' tools); only casing differs ('Hand crossbows').
Expertise at 6th level is a second app entry duplicating the 1st-level desc; fine, but it is the same feature gained again rather than a separate feature.

No mismatch found for hit die (d8), saves (Dex, Int), skill choice (4 from the 11-skill list), subclass level (3), proficiency bonus, Sneak Attack dice (1d6-10d6), core feature names/levels, or Thief subclass features/levels.
